scope: Experimental exact-real mathematical invariant for the positive scalar-removal mechanism in mps/scaled_canonicalize.py. Not floating-point QR or Python refinement.
ambient: Existing TensorTrainCanonical.Chain n l r, Core l r, Word n, contract, absorb; existing TensorTrainNormEnvironment.norm and MatrixProductChain.ofKernel. No new state carrier.
transformation: Divide each chronological core by its supplied positive factor, retaining all dimensions and signs. factorProduct is the chronological product, with empty product one.

statements.contract_rescale: For every Chain n l r, factors : Fin n -> Real, and Word n, contract (rescale C factors) x = (factorProduct factors)^(-1) smul contract C x. Algebraic statement includes zero factors via Lean's total inverse; recovery/normalization below require positivity.
statements.recover_contract: If every factor is positive, factorProduct factors smul contract (rescale C factors) x = contract C x, preserving signed amplitudes and both boundary indices.
statements.norm_rescale: For scalar-boundary Chain n 1 1 and positive factors, existing local Gram norm of rescale C factors = norm C / factorProduct factors.
statements.normalized_action: For scalar-boundary Chain n 1 1 with norm C > 0 and positive factors, contract(rescale C factors,x)[0,0]/norm(rescale C factors) = contract(C,x)[0,0]/norm C. No global-phase quotient.
statements.absorb_recovered: For positive a,b, (a*b) smul absorb(a^(-1) smul A,b^(-1) smul R) = absorb A R; this is the residual-before-absorption scaling mechanism.
statements.boundary_action: Apply recovery to actual MatrixProductChain.ofKernel with arbitrary signed left/right boundaries and retain its literal kernel readout.
statements.hermite_target: Normalize a positively rescaled HermiteExplicitBond.rawSourceChain, obtaining the frozen sampledAmplitude/sampleNorm through existing TensorTrainWord public little-endian indexing. L > 0, k,n natural; physical width n+1.
